docs.title: Abhi Photography
docs.text:
Welcome! I'm Abhi, a hobbyist photographer. This is my free, simple portfolio—no paid domains, just clean photos.

  • Explore my Gallery by category
  • Learn more About me
  • Get in Contact if you want to collaborate

Tip: Click any image to open a lightbox and swipe through.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Hi, I'm Abhi. I enjoy capturing moments—street scenes, travel stories, quiet nature, and the smiles in between.

Gear (optional): - Camera: your model - Lenses: your favorites - Editing: Lightroom / Capture One / etc.

This site is built with Python (MkDocs) and hosted for free on GitHub Pages.
